title: RED metrics per endpoint with per-class and probe-outcome series
iWant: rate, error, and duration measured per endpoint, plus per-class counters and probe outcomes
soThat: dashboards and alerts answer is it up, is it erroring, is it slow for every endpoint without instrumenting by hand

acceptanceCriteria.description: Request rate, error rate, and duration are recorded per endpoint, labelled by path template (never raw paths with ids), method, and status class.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the metrics endpoint or exporter output is read
acceptanceCriteria.then: RED series exist per path template and method, and no label carries a raw resource id

acceptanceCriteria.description: Duration is recorded as a histogram with declared buckets so latency percentiles are computable, not as an average-only gauge.
acceptanceCriteria.then: durations are histograms with the declared bucket boundaries

acceptanceCriteria.description: Per-auth-class request counters exist, so each class's traffic volume and error share are independently visible.
acceptanceCriteria.given: traffic across the four auth classes
acceptanceCriteria.then: each class's requests and errors are counted under its own label

acceptanceCriteria.description: Probe outcomes are recorded under a dedicated metric per probe with success and failure counts, separate from endpoint RED series per AC-2108-6.
acceptanceCriteria.given: steady probe traffic including induced readiness failures
acceptanceCriteria.then: per-probe success and failure counts reflect the induced states

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every declared business endpoint appears in RED metrics after first traffic; there is no unmeasured endpoint class.
acceptanceCriteria.given: one request to every declared endpoint
acceptanceCriteria.then: every declared endpoint's path template appears
